Dear Connections, 

We, in Infosys, are looking for Power Platform developers/architects across India locations.If you are looking for a change or know anyone in your network who would be interested, please feel free to DM me to know more about the role and the opportunity.

ai_analysis.summary: This is a hiring notice from Infosys seeking Power Platform developers and architects across locations in India. It invites interested candidates or their contacts to contact the poster for more information, but it contains no technical knowledge or role details.
